title: NewRec
description: a comprehensive administrative plugin to provide advanced control over permissions, player interactions, and command management
body:
# NewRec
Take full control of your Minecraft server with NewRec, the ultimate plugin for administrators. With a wide range of commands, you can customize gameplay, manage players, and maintain a safe and fair environment effortlessly.

## Commands:
- /build – Enable or disable building for players.
- /pvp – Turn player combat on or off.
- /chat – Restrict chat access for players without permission.
- /limparchat – Clear the in-game chat instantly.
- /hardcore – Send players to spectator mode upon death.
- /hardcorekick – Kick players from the server after death if needed.
- /alternartell – Block or unblock private messages to command executors.
- /stickkb – Give a knockback stick with customizable power.
- /sticksharp – Give a sharpness stick with customizable power.
- /reviver – Revive dead players in spectator mode.
- /interact – Enable or disable player interactions like opening chests or using furnaces.
- /manutencao – Activate server maintenance, kicking non-admin players automatically.
- /rec comando [block | unblock] – Control which commands players can execute.
- /rec chattag – Toggle team tags in chat.
- /rec congelar – Freeze player movement (admins unaffected) and prevent midair abuse.
